    • Expansion edge cases

    The drop-expansion behaviours that are easy to regress.

    Self-closing drop

    The divider below is <drop capsule="button-array" /> written self-closing. If it expanded, this page has button-array styles available.

    Self Closing

    Empty slot

    <drop capsule="footer"></drop> with no children clears {{slot}} instead of printing it. The empty footer bar below should contain no text.

    Unset placeholder drops its attribute

    This photo-card drop sets only data-count. data-path and data-images-path should be absent from the rendered section, not empty strings.

    Attribute escaping

    The gallery above renders titles from JSON. This card's heading contains <, >, &, a double quote and an apostrophe, written directly in the page.

    Tom & Jerry’s <drop> "test"

    If you see raw entity codes or a broken tag here, escaping regressed.

    Drop tags inside protected regions

    The block below is inside <pre><code>. The engine must leave it as literal text rather than expanding it. 

    <drop capsule="footer">
  <p>This should still be visible source, not an expanded footer.</p>
</drop>
